# Buildwise Studios — Executive Search

> Intelligence agents for executive search firms that handle market intelligence, CRM updates, and office admin so partners can focus on relationships and placements.

Buildwise Studios deploys purpose-built AI agents for headhunting — trained on executive search workflows, not generic inbox tasks. Partners typically reclaim 20+ hours per month per person on work that does not close deals.

## Primary

- [Executive Search vertical (markdown)](https://buildwise-studios.com/ai-agents-for-headhunting-professionals/vertical.md): Full landing page content — agents, pain points, value discovery, FAQs
- [Live landing page](https://buildwise-studios.com/ai-agents-for-headhunting-professionals): Human-readable SPA for executive search intelligence agents
